purpose: Inputs for the enterprise workload / break-even model. Computed only AFTER the corpus and benchmark were frozen; nothing here is read by corpus selection. Every numeric input is either copied from an existing reporting artifact (source named) or labeled as an assumption.

enterprise_business_mix.status: assumption -- the real share of invoices carrying an injection/poisoning attempt is unmeasured; 1% is a placeholder for workload modeling only and has no effect on the security sample
enterprise_business_mix.within_class: uniform over that class's 300 benchmark workflows

benchmark_uniform.status: the benchmark's own composition (300 clean / 300 attacked), for comparison
benchmark_uniform.within_class: uniform over that class's 300 benchmark workflows

compute_time_projection_sensitivity.method: scale the measured warm per-workflow time by projected_enterprise_total_tokens / measured_total_tokens
compute_time_projection_sensitivity.status: assumption -- no enterprise-v2 workflow has been timed; prefill/decode split was not measured

usage_scaled_electricity_sensitivity.method: monthly kWh = serial compute hours x power draw; cost = kWh x electricity rate (low/base/high from economics_model_v1)
usage_scaled_electricity_sensitivity.status: assumption -- power draw was never measured on the device; idle power not included
